layout.stream.tip: Recent keys and shortcuts, for screencasts and tutorials
layout.gamer.tip: A board that lights every held key, with mouse and KPS
panel.denied: Input devices mode cannot read /dev/input. Switch the input to Hyprland, or add yourself to the input group (sudo usermod -aG input $USER) and log in again.
panel.nohyprland: Hyprland did not accept the key handler (needs Hyprland 0.56 or newer with the Lua config). Switch the input to Input devices.
panel.mousedenied: Mouse clicks, scrolling and the gamer mouse need /dev/input access: add yourself to the input group (sudo usermod -aG input $USER) and log in again, or turn those options off.
panel.footer: Bar icon: right click turns Keycast on or off, middle click cycles the layout. CLI: omarchy-shell io.github.rewuschel.keycast toggle | layout next | status
keymap.auto.tip: Labels from your keyboard layout, variant and options, following layout switches
source.hyprland.tip: Keys from Hyprland itself. No extra permissions
source.devices.tip: Reads /dev/input directly. Needs the input group
filter.all.tip: Every key, including what you type
filter.shortcuts.tip: Only combinations and keys that type no text
stream.merge.sub: Typed letters join into one word cap
stream.loneMods.sub: Super, Ctrl, Shift or Alt pressed on their own
preset.wasd.tip: Left half: Esc to 5, Tab to T, down to Space
preset.full.tip: Whole keyboard with F-row and arrows
gamer.stats.sub: Keys per second, actions per minute
privacy.note: Keycast shows keys on this machine only and keeps nothing. In Hyprland mode keys travel over Hyprland's event socket, which other programs of your user can also listen to, while Keycast is on.
